nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_omitted
nodes.summary: Zero first or last factors and genuine nondivisor products give canonical zero without reading either zero-index input.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_from_factorization
nodes.summary: A real three-factor equation, three actual signed lookups and two actual products construct a retained grid cell.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_omitted_value
nodes.summary: Every actually omitted grid cell is zero; a retained factorization cannot coexist with its omitted guard.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_factor_product
nodes.summary: Nonzero product cancellation identifies the supplied middle factor; canonical input lookups recover both actual signed products.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_functional
nodes.summary: Each genuine first/last-factor cell has one canonical signed value, without identifying any table representation.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_exists
nodes.summary: Constructively decide the factor guards, extract the actual middle factor, and construct three signed lookups and both products.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_transpose
nodes.summary: Interchanging the first and last factors preserves an actual cell, by proved signed scalar interchange and a real factor-equation permutation.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_flat_entry_exists
nodes.summary: Actual division by S n decodes every flat index, then the genuinely constructed factor cell supplies its signed value.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_flat_entry_coordinates
nodes.summary: Uniqueness of the actual quotient and strict remainder recovers the specified grid coordinates, rather than assuming a decoding oracle.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_flat_prefix_zero
nodes.summary: A genuinely constructed singleton supplies the first flat cell; no finite table or choice axiom is used.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_flat_prefix_append
nodes.summary: Append one actual signed flat cell by real beta-stream extension and preserve all preceding represented values.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_flat_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: Ordinary induction constructs each actual inclusive flat prefix, with an independently witnessed quotient, remainder and signed value at every extension.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_from_flat_prefix
nodes.summary: The actual flat prefix supplies every bounded grid cell; the old checked matrix index bound and unique division prove the row-major decoding.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_table_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the entire real first/last-factor grid, including its harmless extra certified endpoint, from actual input tables.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_table_lookup
nodes.summary: Every actual bounded row-major lookup has precisely the independently defined factor-cell graph.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_middle_factor_equation
nodes.summary: A positive first factor cancels from the actual nested factor equations, identifying the inner convolution quotient.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_from_convolution_entry
nodes.summary: Multiplying an actual inner convolution summand gives the exact factor cell, including zero and omitted inner divisors.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_entry_convolution_product
nodes.summary: Canonical factor-cell functionality identifies its value with the actual scalar multiple of any witnessed inner convolution summand.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_nondivisor_row_value_zero
nodes.summary: A zero or nondivisor first factor forces every actual row cell to zero, independently of input values at zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_factor_row_scalar
nodes.summary: A genuine factor row is the actual pointwise scalar product of a constructed padded convolution prefix, on the identical S n-entry window.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_row_slice
nodes.summary: An actual row slice supplies the exact factor-row values; every affine coordinate is transported by a proved natural equality.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_column_slice
nodes.summary: An actual column slice supplies the exact factor-row values; every affine coordinate is transported by a proved natural equality.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_fubini_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the actual factor grid, both actual signed row/column tables and genuine prefix-sum traces with one common value, by the already proved finite Fubini theorem.

nodes.name: dirichlet_factor_row_zero_sum
nodes.summary: The actual signed sum of a zero or nondivisor factor row is zero; no value at either input zero index is used.

nodes.name: dirichlet_factor_row_sum_product
nodes.summary: Construct the actual inner convolution sum, prove its positive quotient bound, remove its zero padding and identify the row total by actual signed scalar linearity.

nodes.name: dirichlet_factor_row_nested_entry
nodes.summary: Each actual factor-row total is precisely an outer convolution summand of the genuine inner output table, with all positive-index bounds proved.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_row_sums_convolution_prefix
nodes.summary: The actual row sum table is the genuine nested-convolution summand prefix, including every omitted zero row and every proved positive quotient bound.

nodes.name: dirichlet_grid_column_sums_convolution_prefix
nodes.summary: The actual column sum table is the genuine nested-convolution summand prefix, including every omitted zero row and every proved positive quotient bound.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_fubini_interchange
nodes.summary: Actual first/last-factor grid construction and finite Fubini prove F*(H*G)=H*(F*G) at every positive in-domain index; neither a pair permutation nor a rearrangement oracle is supplied.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_associative
nodes.summary: Actual finite Dirichlet convolution is associative at each positive in-domain input, by genuine factor-grid Fubini and the checked divisor-complement commutativity.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_tables_associative
nodes.summary: Any genuine output tables for the two parenthesizations agree on precisely 0<n<=N; no equality of encodings or arbitrary zero values is asserted.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_associative_tables_exists
nodes.summary: Construct all four actual intermediate/output beta tables and prove their positive-domain associativity, including the vacuous N=0 boundary.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Dvd
nodes.summary: The natural number d divides n.

nodes.name: DivRem
nodes.summary: q and r are a quotient and a strict remainder for n by d.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorFourCode
nodes.summary: One canonical injective doubled-Cantor code for all four signed-minor beta-code parameters.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: SignedDecode
nodes.summary: The original canonical integer code: even 2p denotes p, and odd 2k+1 denotes −(k+1). The decoded positive and negative parts are normalized.

nodes.name: SignedBalance
nodes.summary: The original canonical code z represents the integer difference p−n; these supplied components need not be normalized.

nodes.name: ArithTable
nodes.summary: An actual packed signed table with canonical signed entries through index N, including index zero. It contains no divisor transform or inversion hypothesis.

nodes.name: ArithAt
nodes.summary: Two genuine beta entries of the packed table represent the unique canonical signed value z. Distinct component representations need not be equal.

nodes.name: SignedMul
nodes.summary: Actual multiplication of original canonical signed codes; opposite-sign products remain on the negative side of the balance.

nodes.name: DirichletEntry
nodes.summary: At a positive divisor d, witness n=d*q, read the actual signed values F(d) and G(q), and multiply them. Zero and nondivisors contribute canonical zero without reading either input at zero. Source-table validity is separate.

nodes.name: DirichletPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual signed table M records the independently defined convolution entry at every inclusive index 0<=d<=l. The endpoint l is included and can differ from n; no sum or convolution identity is assumed.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: SignedPrefixSum
nodes.summary: The signed balance of two actual natural finite sums, at exactly the indices 0<=i<l. Existence, uniqueness and representation independence are proved separately.

nodes.name: DirichletSum
nodes.summary: Require n>0, construct a real convolution-summand prefix through n, and take its actual signed fold over exactly S n entries. Zero is outside this sum's input domain; no value is assigned by a unit or inversion formula.

nodes.name: DirichletTable
nodes.summary: Three actual finite signed tables whose output H(n), at every 0<n<=N, is the independently defined convolution sum of F and G. All zero entries are unrestricted; only represented positive values, not table codes, are subsequently proved unique.

nodes.name: SignedZeroWindow
nodes.summary: Every actual signed lookup on the half-open interval k<=i<l has value zero. Table validity, existence of folds, and equality after padding are separate hypotheses or theorems, not part of this graph.

nodes.name: ArithSlice
nodes.summary: Actual signed tables with witnessed values G(i)=F(o+s*i) for i<l. The output is constructed by real beta-stream recoding; its separately certified endpoint is unused.

nodes.name: SignedSliceSum
nodes.summary: An actually constructed affine slice followed by its genuine signed prefix sum. Both zero length and zero stride are meaningful; no sum oracle is part of the graph.

nodes.name: ArithRowSums
nodes.summary: An actual row table R contains, at i<m, the signed sum of the n entries F((o+s*i)+t*j). Source and row-table packings are explicit, including empty dimensions.

nodes.name: SignedRectangularSum
nodes.summary: Construct an actual row-sum table and take its actual m-entry signed sum. Equality after swapping strides and dimensions is the independently proved finite Fubini theorem.

nodes.name: ArithScale
nodes.summary: Actual source and output tables with witnessed multiplication of every represented entry below l by the signed scalar a. Sum distributivity is a separate theorem.

nodes.name: ArithPositiveEqual
nodes.summary: Equality of represented values at precisely 0<d<=N. Values at zero are unrestricted, and raw codes or positive/negative representatives are not asserted equal.

nodes.name: DirichletGridEntry
nodes.summary: A retained cell has a!=0, e!=0, an actual middle factor n=(a*e)*c, and the two signed products F(a)*(H(e)*G(c)). Cells with a=0, e=0 or a*e not dividing n are zero. Positivity of n and source-table validity are separate guards.

nodes.name: DirichletFlatEntry
nodes.summary: Witness genuine row-major quotient/remainder coordinates i=(S n)*a+e with e<S n, then require the corresponding actual factor-grid entry. This graph does not itself bound a by n or assume a rearrangement law.

nodes.name: DirichletFlatPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual signed table stores each independently defined flat grid entry at every inclusive index i<=l. Its construction uses finite division and beta recoding; no supplied grid, sum, or Fubini conclusion is built into the graph.

nodes.name: DirichletGrid
nodes.summary: The actual row-major (S n)-by-(S n) factor grid specifies cells a,e<=n at index (S n)*a+e. The underlying table separately certifies its unused endpoint (S n)*(S n). Construction from a flat prefix is a proof dependency, not an extra definition condition.

nodes.name: DirichletFactorRow
nodes.summary: An actual signed row V records the factor cells for fixed a at every e<=n. Its separately valid endpoint S n is unused. No bound a<=n, scalar-sum identity, or associativity law is included as an assumption.
